name: Fortress Value Acquisition Corp. V
summary: Fortress Value Acquisition Corp. V functions as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), created with the specific aim of completing a strategic business combination. This encompasses a range of potential transactions, such as mergers, share exchanges, asset purchases, or corporate reorganizations, involving one or more operating entities. The firm was inaugurated on November 24, 2025, and its principal offices are located in New York, NY.
